name: ASCIIfy
description: Real-time ASCII art conversion from images, videos, webcam, and 3D GLB models. Supports 10 color palettes, CRT effects, and full Framer property panel integration.
author: Yash Chitambar

components.name: ASCIIfy
components.description: Convert images, videos, or webcam feed to real-time ASCII art

components.name: ASCIIfy 3D
components.description: Render GLB/GLTF 3D models as animated ASCII art with optional CRT effects
